summary: Iter104 project-wise expense mapping — full backend + frontend testing PASSED. 10/10 pytest tests pass. UI verified: Add/Edit expense modal has Project dropdown (data-testid=expense-project-select), filter bar has All Projects dropdown (expense-filter-project), table shows Project chip (expense-project-chip-{id}) between School and Category. Project Detail page renders the Expenses card (project-expenses-card) with total (project-expenses-total), Open in Expenses link (project-expenses-open-full), populated table rows (project-expense-row-{id}), and friendly empty state. Backend endpoints POST/PATCH/GET/summary all working with proper 404s for bogus project ids.
critical_code_review_comments: expenses.py is 753 lines — consider splitting P&L computations and CRUD into separate modules for maintainability.
Compound index on (project_id, expense_date) is being created on every list request via create_index (idempotent but adds ~1ms overhead per request). Consider moving index creation to app startup.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is production-ready.
